_note: Acoustic EVIDENCE, never a verdict. A04 reports what the waveform shows. Whether a transient at 5:32 breaches a clause is A11's decision, made with the clause text and an advocate.
_purpose: Deliberately thin. Speaker COUNT needs diarisation — clustering speaker embeddings — and estimating it from energy statistics produces a number that looks authoritative and is guesswork. A04 reports speech PRESENCE and leaves counting to a tier that can actually do it. The specification says never guess unknown sounds; this is the same rule applied to unknown speakers.
